tagline.en: WorldCam — a camera-controllable world model from KAIST, Adobe Research, and MAUM AI, built on Wan2.1.
tagline.zh: WorldCam——由 KAIST、Adobe Research 与 MAUM AI 打造的相机可控世界模型，构建于 Wan2.1 之上。

en: WorldCam is a world model developed by KAIST, Adobe Research, and MAUM AI. It generates video worlds you can steer with precise camera control, and is designed for long-horizon, interactive, game-like scenes rather than short fixed clips.

It builds on the Wan2.1 text-to-video 1.3B backbone, adding conditioning on a camera pose so you can direct how the viewpoint moves through the generated world. In WorldFoundry the runtime is in-tree and supports the official-style conditioning-video path with local WorldCam and Wan assets.
zh: WorldCam 是由 KAIST、Adobe Research 与 MAUM AI 共同研发的世界模型。它生成可用精确相机控制来操控的视频世界，专为长时程、可交互、类游戏的场景设计，而非短促固定的片段。
它以 Wan2.1 文生视频 1.3B 为主干，加入相机位姿条件，让你能指挥视点如何在生成世界中移动。在 WorldFoundry 中，运行时内置于代码树，支持官方风格的条件视频路线，并可使用本地的 WorldCam 与 Wan 资源。

whenToUse.en: Use WorldCam when you want precise camera control over a generated world and are interested in long-horizon, interactive, game-style video.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想对生成世界进行精确相机控制，并关注长时程、可交互、游戏风格的视频时，选择 WorldCam。

notFor.en: Released as code only, so you supply the WorldCam and Wan2.1 weights yourself; it targets camera-conditioned world generation rather than plain prompt-to-video.
notFor.zh: 以纯代码形式发布，权重需你自行准备 WorldCam 与 Wan2.1；它面向相机条件的世界生成，而非单纯的提示词到视频。

en: Precise camera-pose control over the generated world
Aimed at long-horizon, interactive, game-like video
Built on the Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B backbone
From KAIST, Adobe Research, and MAUM AI
zh: 对生成世界的精确相机位姿控制
面向长时程、可交互、类游戏的视频
构建于 Wan2.1 T2V 1.3B 主干之上
来自 KAIST、Adobe Research 与 MAUM AI
